messages:
harper: Quick design review note — users hit the Help fling and then the docs and get mixed terms: Console calls them 'Endpoints', the reference uses 'route' and some examples say 'path'. Feels messy.

jules: Oof. Which term maps to the manifest key?

nina: 'route' is the manifest/YAML field. 'Endpoint' is what support and marketing have used. 'Path' shows up in a few older snippets.

harper: UX problem: the Help panel is tiny on narrow widths. Long parenthetical like 'Endpoints (aka routes)' wraps badly. We should avoid bloating the header.

lex: Accessibility flag: screen reader reads the header verbatim. If the panel says 'Endpoints' but the doc H1 says 'Routes' SR users hear two different labels in sequence. We need ARIA parity.

glossary-bot: search-stats: queries for "endpoint"=49%, "route"=39%, "path"=12% (90d). All used.

jules: Proposal: pick 'Endpoints' as the Console-facing term (most discoverable). In docs, keep API-level 'route' in examples but add a clear alias at the top: "Endpoints (referred to in API manifests as 'route')". Also create /docs/endpoints anchor.

nina: I like that. Add a short redirect from /docs/route(s) -> /docs/endpoints for at least 6 weeks to catch legacy links.

harper: Design compromise: header stays short: "Endpoints". Add a tiny inline micro-link icon labeled 'Terminology' that opens a small anchored glossary modal explaining aliases. No parentheticals.

lex: For SR: set aria-label on the micro-link to "Terminology: Endpoints equals routes in manifests" and update the widget aria-label to "Endpoints help, opens terminology". That will preserve context for assistive tech.

jules: Engineering implementation: add a search synonym mapping (route,path -> endpoints) and a 301 redirect for /docs/routes -> /docs/endpoints. Instrument clicks on the glossary link to measure how often users need the alias.

nina: Docs work: I'll add the alias blurb and the canonical /docs/endpoints anchor, plus an explicit note above code samples: "Note: the manifest field is named 'route'."

harper: Design will mock the inlay micro-link (icon + tiny 'Terminology') and test narrow widths and SR readout. Will post Figma and recording.

qa: I'll schedule a quick accessibility smoke test once design and docs are staged. Focus: SR announce order, truncated labels on mobile, and the micro-link keyboard focus target.

jules: Timeline & owners: docs=nina ~ Wed EOD, design=harper ~ EOD today (Figma), eng=lex next sprint (redirect + search syn + aria). QA will verify post-deploy.

harper: One more UX point: for external-facing marketing pages we should keep 'endpoint' language; internal API docs keep 'route' in examples but always show the alias at the top. I'll add a line in the style guide.

nina: I'll add the style-guide note and include a small changelog entry.

jules: TL;DR: Console label = 'Endpoints'; docs annotate 'route' as API term; add micro-link to glossary; fix ARIA labels; add redirects and search synonyms. Owners noted. :+1:
